title: Polynomial-Time Quantum Algorithm for Symmetric-Group Hidden Subgroups
exact_target: Can a quantum algorithm efficiently recover an arbitrary subgroup of a symmetric group from an oracle that labels its cosets?

sources.citation: Maria Isabel Gonzalez Vasco, Delaram Kahrobaei, and Eilidh McKemmie, Applications of Finite Non-Abelian Simple Groups to Cryptography in the Quantum Era, Section 6, La Matematica 3 (2024), 588-603.
